decisions.reason: As a close-to-core software product with dedicated web presentation and strong fit to the firm's data-driven direction, it is likely to remain above aspiration or be given slack while its market performance is still being learned.

Although only briefly mentioned on the website, it is still close to the established offer, so under bounded rationality and with current growth and hiring the firm would usually keep it unless early results clearly disappointed.

This add-on hardware product is somewhat less central to the firm's digital trajectory, but its own page and usefulness in integrated infrastructure projects make continued retention more likely than withdrawal.

Because it appears to be a more niche equipment item with weaker website prominence, it faces a higher risk of falling below aspirations, yet available organizational slack and adjacency to the core business still favor keeping it for now.

Control technology for water engineering machinery is strategically central to the firm's established systems business, so management would likely tolerate short-term uncertainty and keep it on the market.
